about: My safety plan (specs/1.2-features.md §2, UX 2026-11-09; the Reviewer's read specs/1.2-features-read.md; server specs/safety-plan-server-draft.md, migration 026). TEMPORARY HOME, as content/toolbox.json: it moves to the app repo's supabase/contracts when the app ports it (decision 99). The standard safety-planning structure, every part optional. Sections 1, 3 and 6 are one text each, at most maxTextChars, saved by their own Save. Section 2 is the toolbox list (content/toolbox.json), read and edited in place, never copied. Sections 4 and 5 are people, at most maxPeoplePerSection each, a name of at most maxNameChars and an optional phone of at most maxPhoneChars, in any format (a person in crisis shouldn't fight a validator); Call shows only with at least callMinDigits digits, as a tel: link the phone's own dialer opens. Section 5 also shows the country's helpline, read live from countries.json for Me's country with the help card's rule, never stored and never removable. The plan has content when a text isn't blank, a person is there, or the toolbox has an item: only then does the help card show its button, below the helplines, and a hard Your week its link. An empty plan never blocks help. Names and numbers are other people's: never in logs, crash reports or analytics, never read by Bo or Reflect, in Export, removed by Delete account. No import from the phone's contacts. EVERY string in clinicianDraft is a draft pending the clinician's read (Vitor): safety-plan-live stays off until then.
